product.title: Kona Coast Hualalai Volcano-60Min Helicopter Tour-Door Off or On

description.text: Marvel at the Kona coastline's splendor and the beauty of the Hualalai volcano on this awe-inspiring 60-minute helicopter tour. Begin over ancient Hawaiian Kaloko Fish Ponds and Kailua Bay, then follow Ali'i Drive past Magic Sands Beach and the Captain Cook Monument at Kealakekua Bay before turning inland toward Hualalai's volcanic slopes and Makalawena Beach. Stops include Kaloko Fishpond, Kailua Bay, Ali'i Drive, La'aloa Beach Park, Kealakekua Bay Marine Preserve, Captain Cook Monument. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Kona's coastline, volcanic highlands, coffee country, and island landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
